description: Shell-model nuclear responses W_k^{tt'}(y) = exp(-2y) sum_n a_n y^n.
isospin: the responses multiply the coefficients c^p + c^n (t = 0) and c^p - c^n (t = 1)
interference_order: Phi''M and DeltaSigma' are stored as W_{Phi''M}^{tt'} and W_{DeltaSigma'}^{tt'}, the order the rate formula uses
sources: N. Anand, A. L. Fitzpatrick, W. C. Haxton, Phys. Rev. C 89 (2014) 065501, arXiv:1308.6288
R. Catena, B. Schwabe, JCAP 04 (2015) 042, arXiv:1501.03729
